verdict.rationale: Hands-on accounts show researchers could try Undermind via a 'Try it now' sign-up and run searches before paying. The paid-plan copy advertising '10x higher usage limits' implies a lower-limit tier exists, but no free tier or trial is explicitly documented. Sign-up requires an institutional or company email, which blocked an independent researcher. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of a free tier or trial and its limits, access without an institutional email, and clarity on how many queries a trial allows.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can try the product meaningfully on a free tier or trial

citations.quote: 'Try it now' leads to a sign-up with no social sign-in.
Tried one search and found it impressive.
